A Nash equilibrium strategy suggests bidding slightly below my true value to preserve potential profit margin. I'll bid around $20, which leaves me some potential upside if I win, and minimizes potential loss if I don't win. This balanced approach accounts for the probabilistic nature of other bidders' values.
